name: Acorn Squash
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated due to its low FODMAP content. The natural fiber is beneficial for gut health in most SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until tender
Cut in half, remove seeds, and cube for easier cooking
Can be steamed, baked, or added to soups and stews
Pairs well with low-FODMAP herbs like thyme and rosemary
nutritionalHighlights: Provides dietary fiber for digestive health
